content.title: Effort, Checkpoint, Setback, Recommitment | Return to the Same Route
content.summary: Prove sustained effort before one measurable checkpoint exposes a shortfall. Preserve the performer's emotional and physical residue through a bounded recovery action, then return them to the same route and end on an honest commitment to another attempt rather than an instant victory.

quick_start.input_format: stable adult trainee and route + sustained effort across two related exercises + one measurable checkpoint + visible setback residue + one bounded recovery action + return to the same route + restrained future commitment
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult wildfire-response trainee drags a charged hose down a marked drill corridor, carries one compact sandbag upstairs and checks a timer once. After the missed threshold, they cool both wrists under a short water stream, shut the valve, return to the same hose lane and finish at dusk by tightening both gloves toward the course.
required_anchors: Prove sustained effort in one directional physical task before showing a result.
Add a second mechanically different exercise that serves the same objective.
Keep brief physiological residue through one bounded recovery action, then visibly re-enter the same route or task.
End with a practical reset and steady commitment, not an immediate victory or power upgrade.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Prove sustained effort before one measurable checkpoint exposes a shortfall. Preserve the performer's emotional and physical residue through a bounded recovery action, then return them to the same route and end on an honest commitment to another attempt rather than an instant victory.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin with one clearly adult trainee sustaining a directional physical task long enough to prove effort. Move into a second, mechanically different training action that serves the same objective. Introduce one visible instrument or countable checkpoint only after the effort baseline; let its result trigger a brief setback with observable physiological residue. Allow one bounded recovery action, then require the trainee to re-enter the same route or task direction before any emotional resolution. End on hydration, breath control or equipment reset plus a steady recommitment gaze—never an instant skill upgrade or victory. The reusable mechanism is effort, measurement, setback, bounded recovery, route re-entry and future commitment—not the source magical-girl design, hair, costume, road, park, watch, observers, tears, bottle, exact anime style, camera, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Prove sustained effort in one directional physical task before showing a result.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate measurement provides no evidence of investment.

invariants.rule: Add a second mechanically different exercise that serves the same objective.
invariants.purpose: Shows training breadth without changing goals.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated activity fragments the attempt.

invariants.rule: Use one visible instrument or countable checkpoint to trigger the setback.
invariants.purpose: Externalizes why the trainee's interpretation changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmotivated sadness makes the arc arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Keep brief physiological residue through one bounded recovery action, then visibly re-enter the same route or task.
invariants.purpose: Turns recovery into agency without erasing difficulty.
invariants.ablation_failure: Instant neutrality or a cut to success skips the recommitment choice.

invariants.rule: End with a practical reset and steady commitment, not an immediate victory or power upgrade.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the payoff honest and reusable for persistence stories.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden triumph contradicts the measured setback.

the source roadside guardrail, park, training ground, seated observers, wristwatch, bottle and sunset framing

the source anime palette, linework, shot sequence, camera angles, exact 30-second rhythm and transitions
the source creator identity, Topview and Seedance 2.5 claims, platform overlay, watermark and branding
